text: Been trying to get through for the best part of an hour. My granddaughter is 6, temp 39.9. About twenty minutes ago she had what I think was a fit. She went stiff then her arms and legs were shaking and her eyes rolled back, maybe a minute or so, I'm not sure exactly. She's never had one before. Now she keeps covering her eyes and says the light hurts, so we've had to turn the big light off. She has a bit of a rash on her chest but I pressed a glass on it and I think it went pale. Her colour seems normal to me, lips normal, and she's breathing normally as far as I can tell. I'd appreciate someone actually ringing back this time
